title: [BUG] nothing happens when doing /plugin
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.8.1
- Operating System: Ubuntu 24.04 (WSL)
- Terminal:  Microsoft Terminal

## Bug Description
The [release notes](CHANGELOG.md) mention `/plugin` command, but it doesn't show up under `/help` and nothing happens when doing `/plugin`

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Start claude
2. Run `/help` or `/plugin`

## Expected Behavior

Information on the `/plugin` command should be displayed

## Actual Behavior

No information is displayed
author: Tritlo
